newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Kredietbank launches new world stock fund.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Kredietbank launches new world stock fund.

text.p: Belgian Kredietbank on Friday launched what it said was a non-risk investment fund tracking five world stock indices.

KB said the "World Best Invest 2" fund, to be launched on January 20, offers investors exposure to stocks making up the Financial Times' Eurotrack 200, S&P 500, Topix, and Bel-20 indices and a "New Market" emerging stock market index.
At maturity on October 2, 2000, investors will get back their capital plus 85 percent of the return of the four best performing indices.
Subscriptions run until February 10. Shares in the fund have a fixed price of 50,000 Belgian francs each, plus entry charges.
The new fund will form a compartment of KB's existing KB Equisafe fund.
